까맣다.e: 까만색 = black. 검은색 is another common word for black.

푹.forms: 푹 자다 (sleep soundly) · 푹 쉬다 (rest well) · 푹 익히다 (cook thoroughly)
푹.ex: 이번 주말에는 집에서 푹 쉬고 싶어요.
푹.x: I want to get some good rest at home this weekend.
푹.e: A sound-symbolic word that suggests sinking deep into something.
푹.t: 푹 쉬세요 is a warm way to tell a sick or tired person 'Get plenty of rest.'

방문.x: News of the president's visit came out on the news.
방문.e: Literally 'visit and inquire' — calling on someone to ask after them.
방문.t: Homonym: 방문 also means 'room door' (방 + 문); context tells them apart.

정말로.x: Thank you so much for helping me yesterday.
정말로.e: Literally 'with true words': 정 'true' + native 말 'words' + -로.

특히.ex: 저는 과일 중에서 특히 딸기를 좋아해요.
특히.x: Among fruits, I especially like strawberries.
특히.t: Pronounced [트키] — ㄱ and ㅎ merge into an aspirated ㅋ.

속다.m: to be fooled, to be deceived, to be tricked
속다.ex: 인터넷 광고에 속아서 비싼 물건을 샀어요.
속다.x: I was fooled by an internet ad and bought something expensive.
속다.e: Its causative is 속이다 'to deceive': 속다 is being on the receiving end.
속다.t: The request form is naturally negative: 속지 마세요 'Don't be fooled.'

확대하다.m: to expand, to enlarge; to zoom in
확대하다.ex: 글씨가 너무 작아서 사진을 확대해서 봤어요.
확대하다.x: The writing was too small, so I zoomed in on the photo.

대가족.ex: 옛날에는 할아버지, 할머니와 함께 사는 대가족이 많았어요.
대가족.x: In the past, many large families lived together with the grandparents.
대가족.e: Literally 'big family': several generations living under one roof.

일회용.ex: 카페에서 일회용 컵 사용을 줄이고 있어요.
일회용.x: Cafes are cutting down on disposable cups.
일회용.t: Mostly used before a noun: 일회용 컵, 일회용 젓가락, 일회용 마스크.

고지식하다.ex: 우리 할아버지는 좀 고지식하셔서 규칙을 꼭 지키세요.
고지식하다.x: My grandfather is a bit rigid, so he always follows the rules.
고지식하다.e: Despite the look, probably unrelated to 지식 'knowledge'; it's a native word.
고지식하다.t: Not a harsh insult, but implies sticking to rules or principles without any flexibility.

배타적.ex: 그 모임은 새 회원에게 좀 배타적이에요.
배타적.x: That group is a bit closed off to new members.
배타적.t: Also a legal term: 배타적 경제 수역 means 'exclusive economic zone.'

사실상.x: With this game, the championship was virtually decided.
사실상.e: Literally 'in terms of fact'; -상 = 'in terms of': 역사상, 법률상.
사실상.t: Pronounced [사실쌍]; 사실상 means 'virtually', while 사실은 means 'actually, to tell the truth'.

공유하다.x: Please share the meeting materials with your team members.

노골적.x: He openly showed his dissatisfaction to me.

드넓다.x: Looking at the vast sea makes me feel at ease.
드넓다.e: 드- is an intensifying prefix: 넓다 'wide' → 드넓다 'very wide'.

숙취.ex: 어제 술을 많이 마셔서 숙취가 심해요.
숙취.x: I drank a lot last night, so my hangover is bad.
숙취.t: Koreans fight a hangover with 해장국 'hangover soup', and convenience stores sell 숙취 해소제 (hangover drinks).

덩달아.m: following others, along with others, likewise
덩달아.x: When my friend laughed, I laughed along too.
덩달아.e: From 덩달다 'to follow along without one's own reason'.
덩달아.t: Implies you joined in because others did, not for your own reasons.

경솔히.ex: 남의 일에 대해 경솔히 말하면 안 됩니다.
경솔히.x: You shouldn't speak carelessly about other people's affairs.
경솔히.e: Literally 'light and rash': not weighing your words.

타개책.m: a way out, breakthrough measure (for a deadlock or crisis)
타개책.x: We need a way out to overcome the economic crisis.
타개책.e: Literally 'strike-open plan' — a plan that breaks through a deadlock.

화제성.m: buzz, newsworthiness, how much people talk about something
화제성.ex: 그 드라마는 시청률보다 화제성이 더 높아요.
화제성.x: That drama gets more buzz than its ratings would suggest.
화제성.t: Pronounced [화제썽]; -성 as in 가능성, 중요성, 화제성.

플랫폼.ex: 많은 사람들이 온라인 플랫폼으로 영화를 봐요.
플랫폼.x: Many people watch movies on online platforms.
플랫폼.e: From English 'platform'; the t becomes ㅅ batchim, pronounced [플랟폼].

비판적 사고.ex: 대학에서는 비판적 사고 능력이 아주 중요합니다.
비판적 사고.x: Critical thinking skills are very important in college.
비판적 사고.e: -적 = '-ic/-al' and turns nouns into descriptors: 과학적, 경제적.
비판적 사고.t: 사고 'thinking' sounds the same as 사고 'accident'; context tells them apart.

성토.ex: 회의에서 여러 나라 대표들이 그 나라의 행동을 성토했습니다.
성토.x: At the meeting, delegates from many countries denounced that country's actions.

병변.ex: 검사 결과 폐에서 작은 병변이 발견됐습니다.
병변.x: The test found a small lesion in the lung.
병변.e: Literally 'disease change' — tissue altered by illness.

조변석개.ex: 정부 정책이 조변석개하니 국민들이 크게 혼란스러워해요.
조변석개.x: Government policies change from day to day, so citizens are very confused.
조변석개.e: Literally 'change in the morning, alter in the evening'.

속단하다.m: to jump to conclusions, to judge hastily
속단하다.x: It's too early to jump to conclusions about the result.
속단하다.t: Set phrase: 속단하기는 이르다 = it's too early to tell.

극진하다.ex: 그 집에서 손님들을 정말 극진하게 대접했어요.
극진하다.x: That family treated their guests with the utmost hospitality.
극진하다.e: Literally 'going to the extreme, using everything up': giving all you have.

각기.ex: 같은 영화를 봐도 사람마다 느낌이 각기 달라요.
각기.x: Even watching the same movie, each person feels differently.

상주하다.m: to be stationed permanently, to reside permanently
상주하다.x: A guard is stationed in this building 24 hours a day.

용해되다.ex: 설탕은 따뜻한 물에 더 빨리 용해됩니다.
용해되다.x: Sugar dissolves faster in warm water.
용해되다.t: A science word; in daily speech, 녹다 is used: 설탕이 물에 녹아요.

청초하다.ex: 흰 원피스를 입은 그녀가 참 청초해 보였어요.
청초하다.x: She looked so pure and lovely in her white dress.

개별성.ex: 교육은 학생 한 명 한 명의 개별성을 존중해야 합니다.
개별성.x: Education should respect the individuality of each student.
개별성.t: Pronounced [개별썽] — 성 is tensed after ㄹ.

객체.x: In philosophy, the subject and the object are distinguished.
객체.e: Literally 'guest body' — the thing outside the 'host' self, 주체.

총체.ex: 문화는 한 사회의 생활 방식의 총체입니다.
총체.x: Culture is the totality of a society's way of life.
총체.t: 총체적(인) is common: 총체적 난국, 'an all-around crisis.'
